tagline: Doctor in 10 minutes, from your village

landing.hero_title: Get a Doctor Consultation in 10 Minutes
landing.hero_subtitle: No travel. No waiting. Talk to a specialist doctor from your home via phone or video call.
landing.reality_text: A rural patient travels an average of

landing.process_title: From symptoms to prescription in minutes
landing.step1_desc: Tell our AI assistant what you feel. It screens your symptoms and finds the right doctor.
landing.step2_desc: Pick a doctor, choose video or audio call, and book in under 60 seconds.
landing.step3_desc: Join the call, get a diagnosis, and receive a verified prescription on your phone.
landing.features_subtitle: Every feature is designed for patients who've been underserved by traditional healthcare — low bandwidth, language barriers, and all.
landing.feature1_desc: Optimised for slow rural networks. Audio calls work even with 2G signal.
landing.feature2_desc: Consult in Hindi, Marathi, or English. No language barrier, ever.
landing.feature3_desc: Our AI assistant screens your symptoms and guides you to the right specialist.
landing.feature4_desc: One-tap ambulance booking with live location tracking and 108 integration.
landing.feature5_desc: Verified prescriptions sent to your phone, readable at any pharmacy.
landing.feature6_desc: All your health records are encrypted and only visible to you and your doctor.
landing.testimonial1_quote: My daughter had a high fever at 2 AM. Instead of a 3-hour drive to Pune, I spoke to a doctor in 8 minutes. The prescription was on my phone within minutes.
landing.testimonial2_quote: The Hindi interface made everything so easy. I described my chest pain and the doctor immediately arranged an ambulance. SwasthyaSetu saved my life.
landing.testimonial3_quote: Getting a prescription in Marathi that I could show at the local chemist has changed everything for our village. No more misunderstandings.
landing.about_title: We grew up in villages that had no doctors. Now we're building one for every village.
landing.about_p1: SwasthyaSetu was born at a college hackathon when our team — all from small towns in Maharashtra — realised that our parents would drive 2 hours for a 10-minute doctor visit. We knew technology could fix this.
landing.about_p2: We built SwasthyaSetu (meaning Bridge to Health) to connect rural patients directly with verified specialist doctors through video and audio calls, in their own language, on any phone.
landing.about_mission_desc: Make quality healthcare accessible to every Indian, regardless of geography, language, or income.
landing.about_commitment_desc: Every doctor on SwasthyaSetu is verified. Every consultation is secure and private.
landing.about_tech_desc: Built for low-bandwidth environments. Works on 2G, any Android phone, even basic smartphones.
landing.doctor_cta_desc: Join 1,200+ doctors serving patients across rural India. Set your own hours, consult from anywhere, and make a real difference.
landing.final_cta_subtitle: Available in English, हिंदी & मराठी · Works on 2G · No hidden fees
landing.footer_tagline: Bridging rural India with quality healthcare through technology.
